# Carcavelos Daily Brief — Monday 29 June 2026

**Consistent NW swell building all day with light winds early—solid session potential throughout.**

**MORNING (03:20–11:00)**
Start small at 1.4m, gradually building to 1.7m by 11am. Swell periods lengthen beautifully from 5.7s to 7.9s. Light N winds (11–16km/h) keep conditions clean. **Best window: 09:00–11:00** when swell periods peak, wind lightens, and waves hit 1.7m with shape.

**THROUGH THE DAY**
Steady progression. By midday, 1.8m waves with 8.1s periods arriving. Afternoon stabilises around 1.8m with longer 8.5–8.95s intervals—cleaner, more organised.

**AFTERNOON (12:00–19:00)**
Solid 1.8m sets, offshore-friendly until 17:00. Wind picks up NNW from 15–21km/h after 16:00, getting a bit onshore by sunset.

**TIPS**
Head out 09:00–13:00 to avoid afternoon chop. Bring a shortboard—quality over quantity today. Sunset crowds hit hard; go early or late.
